module purpose: neorv32_hwspinlock implements 32 retained state bits behind a bus request/response interface. A low-address access selects one bit from bus_req_i.addr(6 downto 2) and updates it to not bus_req_i.rw, low-address reads return the selected bit, high-address reads return the whole vector, and the response acknowledges each strobe with err forced low.

use-case flows.value: selected retained state bit updated to not bus_req_i.rw on a low-address strobe for the addressed slot
selected retained state bit returned on a low-address read
full 32-bit retained state vector returned on a high-address read
registered bus acknowledgement and fixed no-error status
all retained state bits cleared and the bus response forced to rsp_terminate_c while rstn_i = '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Retained 32-bit slot state updated by qualified low-address accesses and returned by reads
conceptual assets.reasoning: The operate flow writes one addressed bit of lock_q on (bus_req_i.stb = '1') and (bus_req_i.addr(7) = '0') and (sel(i) = '1'), with lock_q(i) <= not bus_req_i.rw (lines 44-45), so a low-address read stores '1' and a low-address write stores '0'. The read-out flows depend on the same stored state: low-address reads return lock_q and sel (line 68) and high-address reads return lock_q (line 70). Corrupting this state makes both the update rule and the reported values incorrect, establishing Integrity. Availability is also established because lock_q is edge storage (CLOCKED_BY at line 45), is held between accesses, and is cleared only by reset at lines 41-42. The bus request and response ports are complete transport records, so transport exclusion leaves the internal register as the eligible structural reference.

conceptual assets.concept: One-hot decision of which slot a low-address access targets
conceptual assets.reasoning: sel(i) is computed by comparing bus_req_i.addr(6 downto 2) with i (line 51). That decision gates which lock_q(i) may change in the update condition at line 44 and masks which stored bit is returned on a low-address read at line 68. If the decision is wrong, the module updates or reports the wrong stored bit, establishing Integrity for this computed decision. The flow graph lists bus_req_i.addr as CONTROL-ONLY gating sel, lock_q and bus_rsp_o.data; because the bus port is a transport record and port fields are not candidates, sel is the eligible internal realization.
